verdict.rationale: Vercel documents edge-oriented features: Middleware that runs code before requests complete for rewrite/redirect/personalization, on-demand image optimization served from a CDN, and Fluid compute scaling for I/O-heavy workloads — together indicating code execution and content delivery distributed close to end users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of edge network scale/PoP locations, independent latency benchmarks, and hands-on confirmation of true multi-region edge execution.
